detailZones.title: Preparation bench and sink
detailZones.description: Inspect the preparation bench, stainless sink, faucet, cabinets, drawers, refrigerator and counter edges.

detailZones.title: Glassware and drying rack
detailZones.description: Follow the drying rack, beakers, flasks, cylinders, tubes, funnels, droppers and glass bench tray.

detailZones.title: Microscope and bench instruments
detailZones.description: Inspect the microscope, balances, hot plate, clamp stand, instrument cable and bench support.

detailZones.title: Storage and safety wall
detailZones.description: Follow the lockable cabinet, shelves, blank-label bottles, PPE, fire box, eyewash and dispensers.

detailZones.title: Utility cart and cabinet
detailZones.description: Inspect the mobile cart, closed drawers, waste containers, utility sink, lower cabinet and shelves.

detailZones.title: Room fittings and preparation supplies
detailZones.description: Follow the door, window, ceiling services, wall finish, floor, outlets, counter support and safety rail.

anchorAudit.rationale: The source and resized science-preparation-room photographs were inspected at native and final pixels. This batch retains 150 independently pointable bench, glassware, microscope, instrument, storage, safety and room-fixture parts across 6 bounded zones. Student identity, experiments, reactions, hazardous contents, readable labels, measurements, brands and hidden equipment functions were excluded.
